purpose: Define the bounded adapter between Notion/n8n records and the runtime-neutral public change-propagation contract.
authority_note: The adapter translates records and applies only contract-authorized Review/In-progress mutations. It cannot create stronger authority than the underlying contract.
execution_protocol: Read canonical record and capture source version before traversal.
Resolve assets only through Canonical Sources relation.
Filter assets by matching Refresh Trigger class.
Read and snapshot each affected asset before mutation.
Resolve endpoints only through Public Surface Endpoints relation.
Read and snapshot each endpoint before mutation.
Compute intended post-state through the runtime-neutral reference behavior or equivalent conformance logic.
Reject any mutation not represented in allowed_mutations of the machine-readable contract.
Apply mutations using optimistic read-before-write semantics.
Re-read mutated records and compare against intended post-state.
Persist a receipt containing prior state, intended state, observed post-state, errors, and source identity.
Stop. Never auto-promote Review or Block.
mutation_preconditions: Canonical source identity must be resolved.
All target relation IDs must be explicit Notion page IDs or URLs.
Prior state must be captured before writes.
Any target already in Block remains Block.
No target may transition to Pass or Done.
If observed state changes between read and write, abort that target and report PARTIAL/BLOCKED.

deployment.prerequisite: Remote Desktop Commander connectivity and runtime conformance against portable vectors
